platform: Linux; Chromium headless; one configured SMU account
scope: In-process MCP tool execution through operation completion. Excludes model reasoning, stdio startup and remote MCP transport. No concurrent load/capacity test.
method: Sequential live repetitions. Close shared Chromium before first attempt of each case; later attempts may reuse it.

Store redacted counts, timings, completeness, error codes, inclusive phases and optional compact structured JSON byte counts. Do not export names, emails, booking references, cookies or record contents.
Local metadata tools use at least 20 attempts; core live reads use five in the broad/final runs. Equipment matrix uses one attempt per choice/building.
Comparisons use medians of successful attempts, except the explicitly marked upstream task error latency. No p95 claims from fewer than 20 successful samples.
Synthetic fixture times include setup/cleanup. They do not measure real FBS write latency.

skipped.reason: Task listing failed upstream; available tasks are unknown.

equipment.limit: Verifies FBS metadata and availability responses, not the physical condition of equipment.

unresolved: The native FBS Task List returned an application error in all five attempts. Task details could not be benchmarked live; the task list is unknown, not empty.
The broad run began before the skip-description correction; its task_details skip text says no permitted VIEW action. The actual reason was the failed upstream task listing.
Real booking, cancellation and approval submissions were excluded. Fixtures cover validation, reviews, submissions, receipts, duplicate protection, restart recovery and reconciliation.
initial_harness_corrections: History initially lacked a temporary action journal; corrected and rerun.
Library initially used an unsupported GSR-only scope; corrected to available Project Room alternatives and rerun.
